attempts.text: MATCH (a:Issue)-[l]->(b:Issue) WHERE type(l)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND exists{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)} RETURN type(l) t, count(*) c

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WITH p, nodes(p) ns, relationships(p) rs
WHERE size(apoc.coll.toSet(ns))=size(ns) AND all(i IN range(0,size(rs)-1) WHERE exists{(ns[i])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x:Person) WHERE exists{(ns[i+1])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y:Person) WHERE x<>y}})
WITH p, ns, rs
WHERE NOT exists{ WITH ns,rs MATCH (e:Issue)-[l:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]-(f:Issue) WHERE ((e=ns[0] AND NOT f IN ns) OR (e=ns[-1] AND NOT f IN ns)) AND exists{(e)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x:Person) WHERE exists{(f)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y:Person) WHERE x<>y}} }
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] path, [r IN rs|r.linkId] links, count(*) c LIMIT 100

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WITH a,b,nodes(p) AS ns, relationships(p) AS rs
WITH a,b,ns,rs,[n IN ns | head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x) | x.personKey])] AS ass
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..]) AND all(i IN range(0,size(rs)-1) WHERE ass[i] IS NOT NULL AND ass[i+1] IS NOT NULL AND ass[i]<>ass[i+1])
AND NOT exists{ MATCH (a)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]-(f:Issue) WHERE NOT f IN ns AND exists{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x:Person), (f)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y:Person) WHERE x<>y} }
AND NOT exists{ MATCH (b)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]-(f:Issue) WHERE NOT f IN ns AND exists{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x:Person), (f)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y:Person) WHERE x<>y} }
RETURN [n IN ns|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN rs|r.linkId] AS links

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]->(b:Issue), (a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x), (b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE x<>y RETURN count(*) c, count(DISTINCT a) na

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]->(b:Issue), (a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x), (b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE x<>y RETURN count(*) AS c, count(DISTINCT a) AS na
